title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
author: Matt Dinniman
description: Coast Guard vet Carl and his ex-girlfriend's cat Princess Donut, survive an alien invasion by navigating a deadly fantasy dungeon that's actually a sadistic intergalactic reality show.

title: The Deal
author: Elle Kennedy
description: A college student tutors the hockey team captain to make another guy jealous, but ends up falling for him instead.

title: Shield of Sparrows
author: Devney Perry
description: A princess defies her destined role when she seals an ancient treaty with blood and embarks on a perilous journey with a hostile warrior.

title: Don't Believe Everything You Think
author: Joseph Nguyen
description: This book teaches how to overcome anxiety, self-doubt, and suffering by understanding the root cause and accessing inner peace and unconditional love.

title: Foreign Deceit
author: Jeff Carson
description: A deputy investigates his brother's suspicious death in Italy, uncovering deadly secrets amid ancient alleys with a distrustful local agent.

title: Lusitania Gold
author: Fred Rayworth
description: Treasure hunter Detach and his crew search for sunken riches in the Lusitania wreck, facing dangerous secrets and mysterious threats lurking in the Atlantic depths.

title: The Forgotten 500
author: Gregory A. Freeman
description: In 1944, American airmen shot down over Nazi-occupied Yugoslavia were rescued through Operation Halyard, where Serbian villagers helped build a secret landing string for their evacuation.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: An amnesiac astronaut awakens millions of miles from Earth with two dead crewmates. As memories return, he must solve a scientific mystery to save humanity from extinction.

title: Dark Matter
author: Blake Crouch
description: This story follows a physics professor who wakes up in an alternate universe where his life is completely different. To reclaim his family, he must navigate infinite realities while facing his greatest enemy--himself.

title: The Ghost Warriors
author: Bill Tippins
description: A thrilling prehistoric adventure where two young heroes embark on a dangerous quest to rescue their kidnapped friend, only to spark a deadly conflict threatening their entire village.

title: Forbidden Summit
author: Kirk Pocan
description: A team of emotionally broken moutaineers attempts to conquer Danvedi Garwal, the galazy's deadliest forbidden summit, facing deadly predators, rival climbers, and a universe-altering secret.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia
author: C.S. Lewis
description: C.S. Lewis's complete seven-book series follows children who become heroes in Narnia, a fantastical realm where they battle evil, encounter mythical creatures, and discover profound moral truths.

title: Lions of Medina
author: Doyle Glass
description: A gripping account of a Marine company's harrowing battle for survival against overwhelming North Vietnamese forces in the jungles of Vietnam.

title: Get Out of Your Head: Stopping the Spiral of Toxic Thoughts
author: Jennie Allen
description: This book is about how to escape negative thinking patterns and take control of your thoughts, emotions, and circumstances by submitting your mind to Christ.

title: The Love Hypothesis
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: A fake relationship between scientists meets the irresistible force of attraction, throwing one woman;s carefully calculated theories on love into chaos.

title: Assassin's Apprentice
author: Robin Hobb
description: A young outcast bastard son secretly trained as an assassin must use his magical abilities to protect his kingdom from raiders.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: The story of a hero told in his own voice, a tale of sorrow, survival, and one man's search for meaning in his universe, and how that search gave birth to a legend.

title: The Wheel of Time
author: Robert Jordan
description: A young man and his friends are swept into an epic fantasy adventure, pursued by dark forces seeking an ancient prophecy's fulfillment.

title: Stop Overthinking
author: Olivia Telford
description: A practical guide teaching techniques to break free from negative thought patterns, build mental discipline, and achieve mental clarity through self-awareness exercises.

title: The Witcher
author: Andrzej Sapkowski
description: World Fantasy Award winner introduces Geralt the Witcher, who uses magic and training to hunt monsters plaguing humanity while discovering not everything monstrous is evil.
